name: @pane-app/extension
description: Write Pane extensions in JavaScript or TypeScript: the types of Pane's extension contract (wit/extension.wit), web requests (@pane-app/extension/http), toasts, HUDs and the window (@pane-app/extension/feedback), the clipboard, opening, revealing and recycling with the standard actions (@pane-app/extension/system), the session and power commands (@pane-app/extension/system-commands), preferences (@pane-app/extension/preferences), capabilities (@pane-app/extension/capabilities), what a command registers at run time and owns (@pane-app/extension/registrations), the state handoff's serialization helpers (@pane-app/extension/state), icon helpers (@pane-app/extension/icons) and system programs (@pane-app/extension/programs)
